info.title: Loggerhead Comp Rater Quote API
info.description:
REST API for the Loggerhead Comparative Rater. Creates and updates homeowners (**HO3**) and dwelling-fire (**DP3**) insurance quotes for Florida properties.

**Products**
- `HO3` – Homeowners Policy Form 3 (owner-occupied primary/secondary residences). Requires eligibility questions.
- `DP3` – Dwelling Fire Policy Form 3 (rental / non-owner-occupied dwellings). Supports entity-owned properties; no eligibility questions.

The product is selected via the top-level `productType` field. Most of the request body is shared across products; product-specific fields are noted in each field description (`HO3 only` / `DP3 only` / `Conditional`).

**Authentication** – Requests are authenticated at the Azure API Management gateway with a subscription key (`Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key` header). NOTE: Loggerhead's internal reference doc also describes an OAuth2 Bearer token (Azure AD B2C) – confirm whether a bearer token is additionally required for the public endpoints before publishing.

error.description: Populated on failure; null on success.

agencyId.description: Agency identifier. Agency must be set up and provided by Loggerhead.

agentId.description: Agent identifier. Agent must be set up and provided by Loggerhead.

email.description: Must match the agent's onboarded email address.

ApplicantDetails.description: Primary policyholder. For DP3 entity-owned properties, use entity/entityName/entityOwnerDOB instead of the individual name fields.

entity.description: DP3 only. Will the named insured be an entity (corporation, LLC)? If No, individual applicant info is required.

entityName.description: DP3 only. Required if entity = Yes.

entityOwnerDOB.description: DP3 only. Required if entity = Yes. Owner must be 18 or older. Format MM/DD/YYYY.

firstName.description: Applicant first name (required for individual applicants).

lastName.description: Applicant last name (required for individual applicants).

dob.description: Date of birth. Applicant must be 18 or older. Format MM/DD/YYYY.

maritalStatus.description: Marital status. 'Married' and 'Separated' require a co-applicant.

living2YearsInTheProperty.description: HO3 only. Has the applicant lived at the property for at least two years? If 'no', provide priorAddress.

priorAddress.description: HO3 only. Required when living2YearsInTheProperty = no.

CoApplicantDetails.description: Secondary policyholder. Required when the applicant's maritalStatus is 'Married' or 'Separated'; otherwise may be null.

firstName.description: Co-applicant first name. Required if co-applicant present.

lastName.description: Co-applicant last name. Required if co-applicant present.

dob.description: Co-applicant date of birth. Format MM/DD/YYYY. Required if co-applicant present.

maritalStatus.description: Co-applicant marital status. Required if co-applicant present.

sameAsPropertyAddress.description: Does the co-applicant share the applicant's address? If no, provide mailingAddress.

productType.description: Insurance product. Determines which conditional fields apply.

policyEffectiveDate.description: Policy effective date (MM/DD/YYYY). Cannot be in the past; no more than 60 days in the future.

coApplicantDetails.description: Required when applicant maritalStatus is Married or Separated; otherwise null.

consentInsurancePractices.description: Consent to Loggerhead's Insurance Information Practices (insurance score).

assumedCreditRating.description: Assumed credit rating. Only valid when consentInsurancePractices is No.

roofCoverageBuildingCode.description: Indicates whether all roof coverings meet the Florida Building Code or South Florida Building Code at installation, or have a permit on/after 3/1/02, or the roof is original and built 2004 or later.

openingProtection.description: Opening protection. Selecting Basic or Hurricane requires ALL openings rated accordingly per the Uniform Wind Mitigation Inspection Form.

yearRoofReplaced.description: Most recent year the entire roof surface was replaced (YYYY).

coveredPorch.description: DP3 only. Is there an exterior covered porch attached to the dwelling?

Coverage.description: Coverage limits and deductibles. HO3 uses separate Coverage E and F; DP3 combines them into a single Coverage E/F value (see coverageEF). NOTE: the data mapping expresses percentages as decimals (e.g. 0.02) while this spec documents them as percent strings (e.g. '2%') – confirm the exact wire format before publishing.

coverageA.description: Coverage A – Dwelling structure. Currency string. Min $100,000; max $1,500,000.

coverageB.description: Coverage B – Other structures, as a percentage of Coverage A.

coverageC.description: Coverage C – Personal property. HO3: percentage of Coverage A. DP3: currency amount (Primary/Secondary limit $250K, Rental $100K, not eligible when Vacant).

coverageD.description: Coverage D – Loss of use, as a percentage of Coverage A. For DP3, 10% is the only value.

coverageE.description: HO3 only. Coverage E – Personal liability (currency).

coverageF.description: HO3 only. Coverage F – Medical payments to others (currency).

coverageEF.description: DP3 only. Combined Coverage E/F (liability/medical). Allowed values include 'Excluded', '$100,000/$1,000', '$300,000/$5,000', '$500,000/$5,000'. [VERIFY exact JSON key – mapping labels this 'coverageE/F'.]

hurricaneDeductible.description: Hurricane deductible (percent or $500). Not applicable for xWind policies. Cannot be less than the non-hurricane deductible. $500 not valid when Coverage A ≥ $250K.

yearElectricalReplaced.description: Year electrical system was last replaced (YYYY).

yearWaterHeaterReplaced.description: Year water heater was last replaced (YYYY). Older than 20 years is ineligible.

yearHVACReplaced.description: Year HVAC was last replaced (YYYY). Older than 20 years is ineligible.

EligibilityQuestions.description: HO3 only. Underwriting eligibility questions (Yes/No). May be null or omitted; third-party systems may send only the answered questions.

elgOwnedByCompany.description: Is the property owned by a corporation, LLC, LLP, or estate?

elgFiledSuit.description: Have any residents ever filed suit against a home or auto insurance company?

elgPrevailSuit.description: Conditional. Did the resident who sued prevail in that lawsuit?

elgConvictedFraud.description: Has any applicant been convicted of insurance fraud or arson, or been canceled for material misrepresentation?

elgConvictedFelony.description: Have any residents been convicted of a felony?

elgBusinessOnProperty.description: Does the applicant operate a business on the property?

elgBusinessFootTraffic.description: Conditional. Does this business result in customer/vendor foot traffic on the premises?

elgSinkhole.description: Are you aware of any sinkhole activity within 1500' of the property?

elgVacant.description: Is the property vacant, unoccupied, for sale, in foreclosure, or pending foreclosure?

elgVacantMore30Days.description: Will the property be vacant for 30 days or more after the effective date?

elgRentedToOthers60Days.description: Is any portion rented to others (outside family) more than 60 days per year?

elgTwoFamilies.description: Are there more than two (2) families living on the property? [VERIFY field name: data mapping spells this 'elgTwoFamiles'.]

elgUnderAge21.description: Is anyone under age 21 living on the property?

elgDuplicateInsurance.description: Do you have duplicate insurance coverage on this property?

elgRejectedCoverage.description: Has coverage been rejected/canceled/non-renewed in the past 5 years for non-exposure reasons?

elgLapseCoverage.description: Has the applicant had a lapse of insurance coverage in the last 12 months?

elgLapseOver30Days.description: Conditional. Was the lapse in coverage over 30 days?

zipCode.description: 5-digit ZIP code. Provide a mailing address only if it differs from the risk address.

OptionalCoverage.description: Optional coverage endorsements. Field availability and value formats differ between HO3 and DP3 (see each field). [VERIFY value formats – the mapping uses $ strings for HO3 and plain numbers for DP3 on several of these.]

additionalCoverageA.description: HO3 only. Additional dwelling coverage (percentage increase to Coverage A).

additionalFungi.description: Additional fungi/mold coverage. Base includes $10,000/$10,000. HO3 values: $10,000/$10,000, $25,000/$50,000, $50,000/$50,000.

animalLiability.description: HO3 only. Animal liability coverage limit.

hurricaneScreenedEnclosure.description: Hurricane screened enclosure / carport coverage limit.

ordinanceOrLaw.description: Ordinance or law coverage. Base coverage includes 10%.

personalInjury.description: HO3 only. Personal injury liability coverage (e.g. false arrest, detention).

personalPropertyReplacementCost.description: Replacement-cost settlement on Coverage C. Requires Coverage C > $0.

roofSurfacePaymentSchedule.description: HO3 only. Roof surface loss settlement. Roofs 11+ years old must be 'Scheduled'.

supplementalLossAssessment.description: HO3 only. Supplemental loss assessment coverage limit.

lossAssessment.description: DP3 only. Loss assessment coverage. Values: Exclude, 5000, 10000.

waterBackup.description: HO3 only. Water/sewer backup coverage limit.

waterDamage.description: Water damage coverage. HO3: Full / Limited ($10K-$50K) / Excluded.

enum: None - Included In Ext. Wall Construction

zipCode.description: 5-digit ZIP code. Required when applicant has lived at the property less than two years.

squareFootage.description: Heated/living square footage of the dwelling.

numberMonthsOccupied.description: HO3 only. Number of months the property is occupied per year.

managedProperty.description: HO3 only. Is the property professionally managed?

openWaterExposure.description: DP3 only. Is the property adjacent to open water greater than 1/4 mile wide?

typeOfResidence.description: Type of residence. (DP3 adds Condo / Other; HO3 set shown.)

distanceToCoast.description: Distance to the nearest body of water, in miles.

permittedIncidentalOccupancy.description: DP3 only. Permitted incidental occupancy. Default No.

CompRaterQuoteResponse.description: Quote result returned by create/update operations.

eligible.description: Whether the risk is eligible to be quoted.

totalPolicyPremium.description: Total policy premium including all taxes and fees.

additionalCoverageA.description: Echo of additional Coverage A endorsement.

hurricaneScreenedEnclosure.description: Echo of hurricane screened enclosure endorsement.

ordinanceOrLaw.description: Echo of ordinance or law endorsement.

personalPropertyReplacementCost.description: Echo of personal property replacement cost endorsement.

roofSurfacePaymentSchedule.description: Echo of roof surface payment schedule.

supplementalLossAssessment.description: Echo of supplemental loss assessment endorsement.

xWind.description: Denotes the quote has no wind coverage.

bridgeURL.description: Bridge URL for accessing the quote on the Loggerhead Agent Portal.
